policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Study plan version
policies.rule: The version in force at the student's first enrolled term in the program (not the admission decision)

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Study plan migration
policies.rule: A move to a newer version needs an Approved record effective by the approvals date

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Program change
policies.rule: The new program's version in force at the change term; courses remap via the version mappings

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Total credits to graduate
policies.rule: 120 credits (no double majors — not stored, D-025)

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Credits of courses outside the plan
policies.rule: Courses not on a plan line take their course-master credits in the edition they were taken under

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Repeated courses
policies.rule: Latest attempt counts even if lower; credits count once; repeats detected by the engine (incl. renumbered and cross-listed codes)

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Minimum CGPA
policies.rule: The CGPA stored in the SIS must be at least 2.00; a recomputed value only flags a difference

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Gen Ed
policies.rule: ≥ 30 Gen Ed credits; categories from the student's plan; humanities, social and natural science / maths areas; Emirati Studies, advanced English; innovation course from catalog 2025

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Transfer credit
policies.rule: Max 60 cr and ≤ 50% of program credits; grade ≥ C; never onto a capstone line; exchange / articulation credit counts as transfer; never in the GPA

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Residency
policies.rule: ≥ 25% of program credits by own instruction (TR and EX excluded); last 30 cr and ≥ 50% of major credits here

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Waivers
policies.rule: Count only with an Approved record (approver, date, reference, type, policy clause) and within the waiver cap

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Substitutions
policies.rule: Per student, with an Approved Dean record effective by the approvals date (program alternatives too, D-024)

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Cross-listed courses
policies.rule: One course under two codes; counts once; taking both is a repeat

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Gen Ed area met by a major course
policies.rule: Area met only if the course is on the plan's Gen Ed list; credits stay with the major; Gen Ed still ≥ 30 cr

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Major–minor sharing
policies.rule: At most 6 credits may count toward both the major and a minor

policies.label: MANDATED
policies.name: Track study plans
policies.rule: A track is its own approved study plan (StudyPlanTrackID), resolved like any version

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Equivalency
policies.rule: Renumbering and approved equivalencies apply to every student automatically (relations table)

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Split and merged courses
policies.rule: The mappings decide; a merge needs every old course; leftovers go to free electives

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: No double counting
policies.rule: A course counts in one requirement only, except P-15 (area) and P-16 (minor share)

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Prerequisite violations
policies.rule: Flagged for the committee; they don't block graduation. Alternate prerequisites on the line satisfy it

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Grade codes
policies.rule: The SIS grade table (22 codes) decides earned / attempted / in-GPA; grade points not needed

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Academic standing
policies.rule: Not suspended or dismissed in the graduation term

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Internship
policies.rule: INTR390 (6 cr) is required and never waivable

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Credit source
policies.rule: A course on a plan line takes the line's credits, not the course master's

policies.label: SILENT
policies.name: Assignment history
policies.rule: Exactly one current assignment per program, chosen by term range; older rows are history

policies.label: EXPECTED
policies.name: Minimum grade per plan line
policies.rule: A course meets its line only at or above the line's minimum grade; below it the credits go to free electives

relations.note: Same course; taking both is a repeat

The old course meets both new lines
Both old courses needed; one alone goes to free electives

retired_policies.name: Minimum major GPA
retired_policies.reason: No regulator requires it; CGPA is stored
